meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 让 Claude 接入 Signal:通过 signal-cli 把服务作为副设备链接到你手机上已有的号码,收发 Signal 消息。过程中会打印二维码供你扫码授权,并把链接到的号码存为账号。
howto.when: 当你要求给助手添加 Signal 频道,或正在跑 /setup 流程时,它会接管安装 signal-cli、复制适配器、二维码链接与账号绑定这几步。

say.text: 帮我接入 Signal,用我手机上的号码做副设备链接
say.note: 会打印二维码,扫码后等待确认。

say.text: 把这个 Signal 群聊接到我的助手
say.note: 需先发一条消息生成对应记录。

say.text: 把这个 Signal 用户授权为 owner
say.note: 新用户默认被 not_member 拦截。

howto.what_en: Connects Signal to Claude via signal-cli: it links the service as a secondary device on your existing phone number, then sends and receives Signal messages. It prints a QR code to scan and stores the linked number as the account.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Signal channel to your assistant, or while you are running /setup.

say_en.text: Add Signal using my phone number as a linked device
say_en.note: Prints a QR code; scan it to confirm.

say_en.text: Wire this Signal group chat to my agent
say_en.note: Send a message first so the group row exists.

say_en.text: Grant this Signal user owner access
say_en.note: New users are blocked as not_member until granted.
